Page 1455 
Redemplo (plozasiran) 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-505202  
Guideline Name 
Redemplo (plozasiran)  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
2/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Redemplo  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting a diagnosis of familial 
chylomicronemia syndrome (FCS) (type 1 hyperlipoproteinemia)  


=== PDF PAGE 1456 ===
Page 1456 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting one of the following:  
 
 2.1 Genetic confirmation of biallelic pathogenic variants in FCS-causing genes (i.e., LPL, 
GPIHBP1, APOA5, APOC2, or LMF1)  
 
OR 
 
 2.2 A North American FCS (NAFCS) Score of greater than or equal to 45  
 
OR 
 
 2.3 A Moulin score greater than 10  
 
AND 
 
3 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting both of the following:  
 
 3.1 One of the following:  
 
  3.1.1 Patient has tried or will receive treatment with standard of care triglyceride lowering 
therapy (i.e., prescription omega-3 fatty acid and a fibrate)  
 
OR 
 
  3.1.2 Patient has an intolerance to standard of care triglyceride lowering therapy (i.e., 
prescription omega-3 fatty acid and a fibrate)  
 
AND 
 
 3.2 Baseline fasting triglyceride levels are greater than or equal to 880 mg/dL prior to 
treatment with requested drug  


=== PDF PAGE 1457 ===
Page 1457 
 
AND 
 
4 - Requested drug will be used as adjunct to a low-fat diet  
 
AND 
 
5 - Requested drug will not be used in combination with Tryngolza (olezarsen)  
 
AND 
 
6 - Prescribed by or in consultation with one of the following:  
• 
Cardiologist  
• 
Endocrinologist  
• 
Gastroenterologist  
• 
Lipid specialist (lipidologist)  
 
Product Name:Redemplo  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) documenting positive clinical response 
to therapy (e.g., reduction in triglyceride levels from baseline)  
 
AND 
 
2 - Requested drug will not be used in combination with Tryngolza (olezarsen)
